properties.name: lightcrypto.migration.rewrap.enabled
properties.description: Whether the cross-CMK provider re-wrap runner is enabled at startup.

properties.name: lightcrypto.migration.rewrap.dry-run
properties.description: Whether to run in dry-run mode (validation only, no vault mutation).

properties.name: lightcrypto.migration.rewrap.target-provider-id
properties.description: The getProviderId() of the target CMK provider to re-wrap vault keys under.

properties.name: lightcrypto.migration.rewrap.target-public-reference
properties.description: Optional: getPublicReference() of the target provider for disambiguation when multiple providers share the same providerId.

properties.name: lightcrypto.migration.rewrap.target-bean-name
properties.description: Optional: Spring bean name of the target CmkProvider. Takes highest priority over providerId/publicReference matching.
